title: They made an AI think it was a bridge

beats.big:
They made
an AI think
it was a bridge.
beats.say: Scientists made an AI think it was a bridge.
Not with a prompt. They reached inside its brain.

beats.sub: one concept inside Claude: the Golden Gate Bridge
beats.say: Anthropic found millions of concepts inside its AI, Claude. They cranked one, the Golden Gate Bridge, to ten times max.
Then they asked it: what do you look like?
It said it imagined it looked like the Golden Gate Bridge.

beats.sub: "drive across the bridge and pay the toll"
beats.say: Got ten dollars to spend? Drive across the Golden Gate Bridge and pay the toll.

beats.sub: a car that can't wait to cross its bridge
beats.say: A love story? A car that can't wait to cross its beloved bridge.

beats.sub: hours the public could chat with it, May 2024
beats.say: It was real. Anyone could chat with it for twenty four hours in May 2024.
